scope: Built Observer renderer over controlled HTTP snapshots; synthetic pixels; no provider or CLI launch claim

cases.goal: See every portrait and landscape corner in the desktop grid

Open a participant and inspect uncropped stage and filmstrip
Inspect the player and transport without horizontal page overflow
Arrow seek leaves the desktop and shows the addressed recording
Reload preserves the explicit intent to watch live

Same-participant links select the actual visible moment
Reload during recorded playback preserves the displayed capture

Failed polls are visible and recovery receives new evidence
Live views learn actual screenshot shape when an in-progress snapshot omits geometry
Large grids bound desktop connections and allocate visible later lanes

Missing and corrupt image requests recover through a real retry
Native size, zoom and browser fullscreen preserve usable evidence
Browser-enforced fullscreen and clipboard denial retain useful fallbacks
Density and filtering survive reload and show an honest empty result

Save, recall and delete an exact moment without storing evidence or URLs

watch, observe, TUI attachment and library routing need CLI integration proof separately
